newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end supported along curve.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end supported along curve.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended supported along the yield curve with firm buying interest in shorter to medium maturities as yield spreads against Bunds closed just under 75 basis points.
"Ten year bonds are maintaining a spread of under 75 basis points against Bunds, and there is interest from institutional investors in shorter to medium maturities," said one operator.
He added: "Volatility could be less tomorrow because Spain will be on holiday. However, if the U.S. injects a lot of volatility into foreign markets, we could feel the impact here too."
